name: Executive Office
summary: Sets direction, runs the operating plan and looks after our three offices and the plant.
mission:
The Executive Office sets Meridian's strategy and runs the yearly operating plan with every department. It also looks after facilities in Austin, Denver and Rotterdam, and works with the plant leadership team in Tulsa.

Questions about company goals, the all-hands or office space start here.

name: People & Culture
summary: Hiring, onboarding, benefits, pay, learning and everything that makes Meridian a good place to work.
mission:
People & Culture looks after the whole employee journey: hiring and onboarding, pay and benefits, learning, leave, and the policies in the handbook.

Every office has a people partner. If you are not sure who to ask, post in #people-team or email the team.

name: Engineering
summary: Designs the Tidemark meters, the ClearLine filtration controls and the cloud platform utilities use to run them.
mission:
Engineering designs and builds our products: the Tidemark smart water meters, the controllers in every ClearLine filtration skid, and Meridian Cloud, the platform utilities use to read meters and spot leaks.

Teams work out of Denver and remotely, with a hardware lab at the Tulsa plant.

name: Manufacturing & Operations
summary: Builds, tests and ships every meter and skid from the Tulsa plant, and runs the supply chain.
mission:
Manufacturing & Operations builds, tests and ships every Tidemark meter and ClearLine skid from our plant in Tulsa, Oklahoma. The team also runs purchasing, planning and logistics for North America and Europe.

Safety comes first on the plant floor. Read the plant safety policy before your first visit.

name: Sales & Customer Success
summary: Works with the cities and utilities who buy from us, from first meeting to rollout and renewal.
mission:
Sales & Customer Success works with the water utilities and cities that buy from us, from the first conversation through rollout, training and renewal.

The EMEA team works from Rotterdam.

name: Finance & Legal
summary: Budgets, payroll, expenses, contracts and compliance.
mission:
Finance & Legal runs budgets and forecasting, payroll, expenses and purchasing approvals, and reviews every customer and supplier contract.

Expense questions go to #finance. Contract reviews go through the legal request form in the resource library.

name: IT & Security
summary: Keeps our laptops, accounts, network and data safe and working. Runs the service desk.
mission:
IT & Security runs the service desk, manages laptops, phones and accounts, keeps the network up in every office and the plant, and protects company and customer data.

Most answers are in IT help. For anything urgent, call the service desk on extension 4357 (HELP).

name: Marketing & Communications
summary: Our brand, website, trade shows, press and internal communications, including this hub.
mission:
Marketing & Communications looks after the Meridian brand, our website, trade shows and press, and internal communications, including Meridian Hub and the all-hands.

Want to post an announcement? Talk to the internal comms team.
